question: Which of the following organisations was founded by Jyotiba Phule to propagate caste equality?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyashodhak Samaj**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyashodhak Samaj** was founded by Jyotiba Phule in 1873.
 
• The organization aimed to promote social equality and fight against the caste system in India.
 
• Jyotiba Phule established the Satyashodhak Samaj to provide education to the lower castes and encourage them to stand up against social discrimination.
 
• The Samaj also worked towards the upliftment of women and fought against practices like child marriage.
 
• It played a significant role in the social reform movements of the 19th century in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotiba Phule** is regarded as one of the pioneers of the social reform movement in India.
 
• He and his wife, **Savitribai Phule**, were instrumental in starting the first school for girls in Pune in 1848.
 
• The Phule couple also worked towards the eradication of untouchability and upliftment of the marginalized sections of society.
 
• The Satyashodhak Samaj inspired many other social reformers and movements in India, including Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and the Dalit movement.
 
• Jyotiba Phule's contributions to social reform have left an indelible mark on Indian society, and he is remembered as a champion of social justice and equality.
